title: REQ · gridToRgba converts a palette-indexed grid to RGBA and rejects bad indices
summary: A pure function maps a grid of palette indices to an RGBA byte array using only palette colours.
description: Context: palette colours are hex strings in PALETTE. Desired behaviour: gridToRgba(grid) returns width, height and a Uint8ClampedArray of RGBA. Index -1 means transparent (alpha 0); any other index outside 0..PALETTE.length-1, or a non-integer, throws a RangeError; rows of unequal length throw. Expected result: every opaque pixel equals a PALETTE colour. Why: guarantees art uses only the shared palette.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 3x2 grid, when converted, then width is 3, height is 2 and data length is 24.
Given any valid grid, when converted, then each opaque pixel's rgb matches the hex of PALETTE[index] with alpha 255.
Given index 48, -2 or 1.5, when converted, then a RangeError is thrown.
Given the same grid twice, when converted, then the byte arrays are equal.
technical_constraints: Palette of at most 48 colours, defined once and reused.
